blocks.zh: 房間功能與傳遞區（中）
blocks.en: Room Functions and Transfer Zones (Part 2)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Identify the five general functional categories of facility areas and their roles in sterile manufacturing. / 辨識設施區域的五大功能分類及其在無菌製造中的角色。
blocks.en: Identify the five general functional categories of facility areas and their roles in sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Explain the design requirements for changing rooms, including gowning philosophy and ingress/egress control. / 說明更衣室的設計要求，包括更衣策略與進出動線控制。
blocks.en: Explain the design requirements for changing rooms, including gowning philosophy and ingress/egress control.

blocks.zh: Describe how surface finishes and materials of construction vary by area classification (Grade D through Grade A). / 描述不同區域等級（D 級至 A 級）的表面處理與建材要求差異。
blocks.en: Describe how surface finishes and materials of construction vary by area classification (Grade D through Grade A).

blocks.zh: Compare airlock types (PAL, MAL, pass-through) and their design philosophies for contamination control. / 比較各類氣閘（人員氣閘、物料氣閘、傳遞窗）及其污染控制設計策略。
blocks.en: Compare airlock types (PAL, MAL, pass-through) and their design philosophies for contamination control.

blocks.zh: Apply the concept of "improvement step" and sequential transitions to design compliant transfer zone procedures. / 將「改善步驟」與逐級轉換概念應用於傳遞區程序的合規設計。
blocks.en: Apply the concept of "improvement step" and sequential transitions to design compliant transfer zone procedures.

blocks.zh: Section Navigator / 章節導覽
blocks.en: Section Navigator

blocks.zh: 房間功能分類  |  p. 92–93
blocks.en: Room Function Categories | p. 92-93

blocks.zh: 房間功能五大分類
blocks.en: The Five Functional Categories of Rooms

blocks.zh: ISPE 將無菌設施分成五個層級，從最核心的無菌製程區到最外圈的一般支援區，層層遞進。理解這五層結構是設計潔淨室布局的基礎。
blocks.en: ISPE divides a sterile facility into five levels, from the aseptic processing core at the center to the general support areas at the outer edge. Understanding this five-layer structure is the basis for laying out a cleanroom facility.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：由內到外五圈防護
blocks.en: Key concept: five rings of protection, from the inside out

blocks.zh: 第一圈：無菌製程核心（Grade A/B）— 產品直接暴露區
blocks.en: Ring 1: Aseptic processing core (Grade A/B) - the area where product is directly exposed

blocks.zh: 第二圈：緊鄰氣閘與人員/物料轉換區
blocks.en: Ring 2: Adjacent airlocks and personnel/material transition areas

blocks.zh: 第三圈：準備區（配液、清洗、組裝）
blocks.en: Ring 3: Preparation areas (solution preparation, washing, assembly)

blocks.zh: 第四圈：製藥區（檢驗、乾淨更衣、物料暫存）
blocks.en: Ring 4: Pharmaceutical areas (testing, clean changing, material staging)

blocks.zh: 第五圈：一般輔助區（倉庫、辦公室、公用工程）
blocks.en: Ring 5: General support areas (warehouse, offices, utilities)

blocks.zh: 比喻：洋蔥式防護
blocks.en: Analogy: the onion

blocks.zh: 想像整個設施是一顆洋蔥 — 每一層都是一道屏障。越靠近中心（無菌核心），環境控制越嚴格；每跨越一層，都必須經過一個「轉換站」（氣閘或更衣室）。這就是為什麼設施布局必須從核心向外規劃。
blocks.en: Picture the whole facility as an onion: every layer is a barrier. The closer you get to the center (the aseptic core), the stricter the environmental control, and every layer you cross must go through a "transition station" (an airlock or changing room). This is why the facility layout has to be planned from the core outward.

blocks.zh: 更衣室設計  |  p. 93
blocks.en: Changing Room Design | p. 93

blocks.zh: 更衣室設計要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Changing Room Design

blocks.zh: 更衣室設計四大原則
blocks.en: Four Principles of Changing Room Design

blocks.zh: 邏輯遞進：人員從一般更衣室（換廠服）逐步進入潔淨更衣室（穿無塵衣），分階段完成。
blocks.en: Logical progression: Personnel move from the general changing room (changing into plant garments) step by step into the clean changing room (donning cleanroom garments), completing gowning in stages.

blocks.zh: 進出分離：進入無菌區（含 RABS）的更衣室應盡可能設計獨立的進入與離開路線，避免乾淨衣物被汙染。
blocks.en: Separate ingress and egress: Changing rooms leading into aseptic areas (including RABS) should, where possible, have separate entry and exit routes to avoid contaminating clean garments.

blocks.zh: 等級匹配：更衣室的環境控制標準應匹配它所通往的最高潔淨等級。
blocks.en: Grade matching: The environmental control standard of a changing room should match the highest cleanliness grade it leads to.

blocks.zh: 隔離廁所：淋浴間與廁所不得直接連通分級潔淨室或更衣區。
blocks.en: Isolated toilets: Showers and toilets must not open directly into classified cleanrooms or gowning areas.

blocks.zh: 實務提醒
blocks.en: Practical Reminder

blocks.zh: 更衣室的「進出分離」原則在稽核中是常見缺失項。許多舊廠因空間限制，進出共用同一條走廊。若無法實體分離，至少需要有 SOP 規定同時只允許單向通行（gowning 或 de-gowning），並以 HVAC 正壓流向作為補償措施。
blocks.en: Separation of ingress and egress in changing rooms is a common audit finding. Many older plants share one corridor for both because of space constraints. If physical separation is not possible, at a minimum an SOP should allow only one-way traffic at a time (either gowning or de-gowning), with HVAC positive-pressure airflow as a compensating measure.

blocks.zh: 散裝儲存區  |  p. 93
blocks.en: Bulk Storage Areas | p. 93

blocks.zh: 散裝儲存區設計
blocks.en: Bulk Storage Area Design

blocks.zh: 大宗物料倉儲區通常遠離潔淨核心。但某些中間產品、成品或零組件可能需要暫存於準備區或無菌製程區內。此類暫存區需有專屬空間並可能需要特殊的 HVAC 設計（如溫濕度控制）。
blocks.en: Bulk material storage areas are normally located well away from the clean core. However, some intermediates, finished products or components may need to be held temporarily in the preparation area or the aseptic processing area. Such holding areas need dedicated space and may need special HVAC design (such as temperature and humidity control).

blocks.zh: 比喻：廚房的食材暫存
blocks.en: Analogy: holding ingredients in a kitchen

blocks.zh: 大倉庫像是餐廳後方的冷藏庫（遠離料理區），但廚房內通常還需要一個小型工作台冰箱來暫放即將使用的食材。潔淨室內的暫存區就是這個「工作台冰箱」— 空間小、控管嚴、只放即將投入製程的物料。
blocks.en: The big warehouse is like the walk-in cooler at the back of a restaurant (far from the cooking area), but the kitchen usually also needs a small under-counter fridge for ingredients about to be used. The holding area inside a cleanroom is that "under-counter fridge": small, tightly controlled, and holding only the materials that are about to go into the process.

blocks.zh: 表面處理與建材  |  p. 93–94
blocks.en: Surface Finishes and Materials of Construction | p. 93-94

blocks.zh: 建築細節設計
blocks.en: Architectural Detail Design

blocks.zh: 潔淨室表面處理六大原則
blocks.en: Six Principles for Cleanroom Surface Finishes

blocks.zh: 不脫落（Non-shedding）：材料不會釋出微粒
blocks.en: Non-shedding: The material does not release particles

blocks.zh: 不滲透（Non-porous）：表面不吸收液體或微生物
blocks.en: Non-porous: The surface does not absorb liquids or microorganisms

blocks.zh: 抗微生物：不利於微生物在表面附著生長
blocks.en: Antimicrobial: The surface does not favor microbial attachment and growth

blocks.zh: 易清潔：表面光滑、接縫最少、牆角圓弧化（Coved）
blocks.en: Easy to clean: Smooth surfaces, minimal joints, coved corners

blocks.zh: 耐化學品：能承受反覆清潔消毒，不氧化腐蝕
blocks.en: Chemical resistance: Withstands repeated cleaning and disinfection without oxidation or corrosion

blocks.zh: 耐衝擊：需考慮防撞設施，尤其是高流量區域
blocks.en: Impact resistance: Impact protection should be considered, especially in high-traffic areas

blocks.zh: 門的設計 — 壓差與消防的兩難
blocks.en: Door Design - the Pressure Differential versus Fire Safety Dilemma

blocks.zh: 門應朝壓力較高的一側開啟，以維持壓差。但消防法規要求門朝逃生方向開啟。這兩個需求常互相衝突，尤其在 Grade B 以上區域。解決方案通常是加裝足夠力量的門弓器（Door Closer）來克服壓差，並且設置緊急開門覆蓋功能。
blocks.en: Doors should open toward the higher-pressure side to maintain the pressure differential. Fire regulations, however, require doors to open in the direction of escape. The two requirements often conflict, especially in areas of Grade B and above. The usual solution is to fit door closers strong enough to overcome the pressure differential, together with an emergency door-release override.

blocks.zh: 比喻：表面處理像選「防水手機殼」
blocks.en: Analogy: choosing surface finishes is like choosing a waterproof phone case

blocks.zh: 潔淨室的表面處理就像選手機保護殼一樣 — 你需要它防水（不滲透）、防摔（耐衝擊）、好擦拭（易清潔），而且不能掉漆（不脫落）。越高等級的潔淨室，就像越昂貴的手機，需要越高規格的保護。
blocks.en: Choosing cleanroom surface finishes is like choosing a protective phone case: you need it to be waterproof (non-porous), shockproof (impact resistant), easy to wipe (easy to clean) and not flake (non-shedding). The higher the cleanroom grade, the more expensive the "phone", and the higher the specification of protection it needs.

blocks.zh: 稽核觀點：外觀即品質
blocks.en: Audit Perspective: Appearance Is Quality

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別指出：高品質的表面處理可以向稽核員傳達對品質的承諾。反之，老舊脫落的牆面或生鏽的門框會讓稽核員對整個設施的管理水準產生懷疑。這不只是美觀問題，更是 GMP 文化的展現。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically notes that a high-quality finish can convey a commitment to quality to auditors. Conversely, peeling old walls or rusty door frames lead auditors to doubt the management standard of the whole facility. This is not just a matter of appearance; it is a demonstration of GMP culture.

blocks.zh: 建材與表面處理指引表  |  p. 94–97
blocks.en: Materials and Finishes Guidance Table | p. 94-97

blocks.zh: Table 4.2 關鍵解讀
blocks.en: Key Points from Table 4.2

blocks.zh: 建材等級速查邏輯
blocks.en: Quick Logic for Material Grades

blocks.zh: 隨著區域等級從「未分級」升至 Grade A，建材要求呈現明確的階梯式升級：
blocks.en: As the area classification rises from unclassified to Grade A, material requirements step up clearly:

blocks.zh: 地板：密封混凝土 → 環氧樹脂/乙烯基 → 焊縫乙烯基+圓弧踢腳板 → 禁止排水口
blocks.en: Floors: sealed concrete → epoxy/vinyl → welded-seam vinyl with coved skirting → no drains

blocks.zh: 牆壁：乳膠漆石膏板 → 金屬面板/釉面磚 → 化學抗性塗料 → 無縫隙、圓角、抗腐蝕
blocks.en: Walls: latex-painted gypsum board → metal panels/glazed tile → chemical-resistant coating → seamless, coved corners, corrosion resistant

blocks.zh: 天花板：懸吊式天花 → FRP/金屬面板 → 密封齊平安裝 → HEPA 過濾器陣列（UAF）
blocks.en: Ceilings: suspended ceiling → FRP/metal panels → sealed, flush-mounted → HEPA filter array (UAF)

blocks.zh: 門：標準五金 → 環氧塗裝金屬 → 全不鏽鋼 + 免接觸感應器
blocks.en: Doors: standard hardware → epoxy-coated metal → all stainless steel + touch-free sensors

blocks.zh: Grade A 的獨特要求
blocks.en: Unique Requirements for Grade A

blocks.zh: 禁止排水口和水槽（Floor drains and sinks are not permitted）
blocks.en: Drains and sinks are not permitted (Floor drains and sinks are not permitted)

blocks.zh: 天花板由 HEPA/ULPA 過濾器陣列組成，提供單向氣流（UAF）
blocks.en: The ceiling consists of an array of HEPA/ULPA filters providing unidirectional airflow (UAF)

blocks.zh: 消防噴頭必須為不擾動 UAF 的特殊設計
blocks.en: Fire sprinklers must be a special design that does not disturb the UAF

blocks.zh: 所有門把五金為凹入式、免接觸致動器
blocks.en: All door hardware is recessed with touch-free actuators

blocks.zh: 比喻：從一般廚房到手術室
blocks.en: Analogy: from a home kitchen to an operating theater

blocks.zh: 未分級區就像家裡的廚房 — 用瓷磚地板、塗漆牆壁就足夠了。Grade C/D 像是餐廳後廚 — 需要不鏽鋼檯面和可沖洗地板。Grade A 則像手術室 — 天花板就是層流出風口、牆角全部圓弧化、地上不能有一個排水孔。每升一級，就更接近「零死角、零藏污」的極致標準。
blocks.en: An unclassified area is like a kitchen at home: tile floors and painted walls are enough. Grade C/D is like a restaurant back kitchen, needing stainless steel counters and washable floors. Grade A is like an operating theater: the ceiling is the laminar-flow air outlet, every corner is coved, and there is not a single drain in the floor. With every step up in grade, you move closer to the ultimate standard of "no dead corners, nowhere for dirt to hide".

blocks.zh: 常見稽核缺失：石膏板發霉
blocks.en: Common Audit Finding: Mold on Gypsum Board

blocks.zh: Table 4.2 的 Note 2 特別警告：石膏板（Gypsum Board）在高濕度或頻繁清潔消毒區域有發霉風險。若必須使用，應選擇玻璃面或抗菌石膏板。這是新廠設計時最容易忽略、舊廠最常出問題的建材議題。
blocks.en: Note 2 of Table 4.2 specifically warns that gypsum board carries a risk of mold in areas of high humidity or frequent cleaning and disinfection. If it must be used, choose glass-faced or antimicrobial gypsum board. This is the material issue most easily overlooked in new plant design and most often problematic in older plants.

blocks.zh: 房間表面規格  |  p. 98
blocks.en: Room Surface Specifications | p. 98

blocks.zh: 房間表面規格選擇要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Selecting Room Surface Specifications

blocks.zh: 表面規格選擇的決策因素
blocks.en: Decision Factors in Selecting Surface Specifications

blocks.zh: 製程需求：同一等級房間內，開放式製程 vs. 隔離器操作，對表面要求天差地別
blocks.en: Process requirements: Within the same room grade, open processing versus isolator operation makes a huge difference to surface requirements

blocks.zh: 安裝 vs. 維護成本：選材時需平衡初始安裝成本與長期維護/更換的便利性
blocks.en: Installation vs. maintenance cost: Material selection must balance initial installation cost against long-term ease of maintenance and replacement

blocks.zh: 系統整合：牆面必須容納 CCTV、對講機、門禁、消防噴頭等多種設備
blocks.en: System integration: Walls must accommodate CCTV, intercoms, access control, fire sprinklers and many other devices

blocks.zh: 氣密性：門框、噴頭、穿管等所有開口都必須密封，維持壓差控制
blocks.en: Airtightness: All openings, including door frames, sprinklers and penetrations, must be sealed to maintain pressure differential control

blocks.zh: 防爆：有溶劑的區域需考慮防靜電導電地板
blocks.en: Explosion protection: Areas with solvents should consider anti-static conductive flooring

blocks.zh: 排水口管控 — 微生物風險熱點
blocks.en: Drain Control - a Microbial Risk Hot Spot

blocks.zh: 排水口是潔淨室微生物汙染的高風險點。ISPE 的立場非常明確：
blocks.en: Drains are a high-risk point for microbial contamination in cleanrooms. ISPE's position is very clear:

blocks.zh: 無菌製程區（Aseptic Area）：完全禁止排水口
blocks.en: Aseptic area: drains are completely prohibited

blocks.zh: 準備區等其他區域：排水口應最小化，且必須使用凹面設計、至少 2 吋空氣斷口、逆流防止器與存水彎控制器
blocks.en: Preparation and other areas: drains should be minimized, and must use a recessed design, an air break of at least 2 inches, backflow preventers and trap controllers

blocks.zh: 排水口的微生物回溯汙染（Backsplash/Backflow）是導致無菌測試失敗與批次報廢的常見原因之一。
blocks.en: Microbial backsplash/backflow from drains is one of the common causes of sterility test failures and batch rejection.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Thought Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的 Grade C 準備區目前使用環氧樹脂地板搭配排水口，用於清洗作業排水。最近連續兩次環境監測發現排水口附近的微生物計數偏高。你會考慮哪些改善措施？
blocks.en: Your Grade C preparation area currently uses an epoxy floor with a drain for wash-down. In the last two consecutive environmental monitoring runs, microbial counts near the drain were high. Which corrective measures would you consider?

blocks.zh: 增加排水口的清潔消毒頻率
blocks.en: Increase the cleaning and disinfection frequency of the drain

blocks.zh: 安裝逆流防止器與存水彎監控器
blocks.en: Install a backflow preventer and a trap monitor

blocks.zh: 評估是否能減少排水口數量或重新配置位置
blocks.en: Assess whether the number of drains can be reduced or their locations reconfigured

blocks.zh: 在排水口上加裝密封蓋，僅在排水時打開
blocks.en: Fit a sealing cover over the drain, opened only during draining

blocks.zh: 傳遞區（氣閘系統）  |  p. 98–99
blocks.en: Transfer Zones (Airlock Systems) | p. 98-99

blocks.zh: 傳遞區總論
blocks.en: Overview of Transfer Zones

blocks.zh: 氣閘（Airlock）的三大功能
blocks.en: The Three Functions of an Airlock

blocks.zh: 維持壓差：作為不同等級區域之間的緩衝空間，防止一開門就破壞壓差梯度
blocks.en: Maintain pressure differential: Acts as a buffer space between areas of different grades, so that opening a door does not immediately collapse the pressure gradient

blocks.zh: 提供轉換環境：人員更衣、物料清潔消毒等「改善步驟」在此完成
blocks.en: Provide a transition environment: Gowning of personnel and cleaning and disinfection of materials, the "improvement steps", are completed here

blocks.zh: 降低交叉污染風險：通過門互鎖、單向流動等機制，確保低等級空氣不進入高等級區域
blocks.en: Reduce cross-contamination risk: Through mechanisms such as door interlocks and one-way flow, ensure that lower-grade air does not enter higher-grade areas

blocks.zh: 比喻：潛水艇的壓力艙
blocks.en: Analogy: the submarine pressure chamber

blocks.zh: 氣閘就像潛水艇上的壓力艙（Airlock）— 你不能直接從海水中走進潛艇內部，必須先進入壓力艙、關閉外門、調整壓力、再打開內門。潔淨室的氣閘也是一樣的概念：關門 → 執行清潔/更衣 → 等待壓差恢復 → 再開另一扇門。兩扇門永遠不能同時打開。
blocks.en: An airlock is like the pressure chamber on a submarine: you cannot walk straight from the sea into the submarine; you must first enter the chamber, close the outer door, adjust the pressure, and then open the inner door. A cleanroom airlock works on the same concept: close the door → carry out cleaning/gowning → wait for the pressure differential to recover → open the other door. The two doors must never be open at the same time.

blocks.zh: 改善步驟  |  p. 99
blocks.en: Improvement Step | p. 99

blocks.zh: 改善步驟 — 每次跨級都要「升級」
blocks.en: Improvement Step - Every Grade Crossing Must Be an "Upgrade"

blocks.zh: 「改善步驟」核心規則
blocks.en: Core Rule of the "Improvement Step"

blocks.zh: 從低等級區域進入高等級區域時，必須執行一項能提升清潔度的具體行動（Improvement Step）：
blocks.en: When moving from a lower-grade area to a higher-grade area, a specific action that raises cleanliness (an improvement step) must be carried out:

blocks.zh: 物料：拆除外包裝 / 擦拭消毒 / 燻蒸除汙
blocks.en: Materials: remove outer packaging / wipe-down disinfection / fumigation decontamination

blocks.zh: 人員：加穿一層防護衣物
blocks.en: Personnel: put on an additional layer of protective garments

blocks.zh: 轉換線（Transition Line）
blocks.en: Transition Line

blocks.zh: 氣閘內應設置視覺明確的「轉換線」— 物料必須在清潔消毒完成後才能跨越此線。這是一個簡單但極為有效的防汙染措施。在 ISO 8/Grade C 及更高等級的氣閘中，ISPE 明確建議設置轉換線。
blocks.en: A clearly visible "transition line" should be set up inside the airlock - materials may cross it only after cleaning and disinfection are complete. This is a simple but highly effective contamination control measure. For airlocks of ISO 8/Grade C and higher, ISPE explicitly recommends providing a transition line.

blocks.zh: 實務上，轉換線可以是地板上一條醒目的彩色膠帶或嵌入式標線。有些設施甚至使用不同顏色的地板來區分「髒側」和「乾淨側」。
blocks.en: In practice, the transition line can be a conspicuous strip of colored tape or an inlaid marking on the floor. Some facilities even use different floor colors to distinguish the "dirty side" from the "clean side".

blocks.zh: 比喻：機場安檢線
blocks.en: Analogy: the airport security line

blocks.zh: 就像過機場安檢一樣 — 行李（物料）要過 X 光機（消毒），人要脫外套過金屬探測門（換穿防護衣）。安檢線前後是不同管制等級的區域，你不能帶著未經檢查的東西越過那條線。
blocks.en: It is like passing through airport security: luggage (materials) goes through the X-ray machine (disinfection), and people take off their coats and pass through the metal detector (change into protective garments). The areas before and after the security line have different control levels, and you cannot carry anything unchecked across that line.

blocks.zh: 逐級轉換  |  p. 99
blocks.en: Sequential Transitions | p. 99

blocks.zh: 逐級轉換的關鍵規則
blocks.en: Key Rules for Sequential Transitions

blocks.zh: 等級轉換路徑圖
blocks.en: Grade Transition Pathway

blocks.zh: 進入時必須逐級升級：
blocks.en: On entry, you must step up one grade at a time:

blocks.zh: 未分級 → CNC/Grade D → ISO 8/Grade C → ISO 7/Grade B → ISO 5/Grade A
blocks.en: Unclassified → CNC/Grade D → ISO 8/Grade C → ISO 7/Grade B → ISO 5/Grade A

blocks.zh: 每一個「→」都代表一個氣閘轉換
blocks.en: Each "→" represents an airlock transition

blocks.zh: 不可跳級（例如不可從 Grade D 直接進入 Grade B）
blocks.en: No skipping grades (for example, you may not go directly from Grade D to Grade B)

blocks.zh: 退出時可以跳級，但 Grade B 出口仍建議設 Grade B 氣閘以保護核心區
blocks.en: On exit, grades may be skipped, but a Grade B exit is still recommended to have a Grade B airlock to protect the core area

blocks.zh: Grade A 與 Grade B 的特殊關係
blocks.en: The Special Relationship Between Grade A and Grade B

blocks.zh: Grade A 與 Grade B 之間通常不設氣閘（因為 Grade A 本身就在 Grade B 環境內），但必須有：
blocks.en: There is usually no airlock between Grade A and Grade B (because Grade A sits inside the Grade B environment), but there must be:

blocks.zh: 清晰的視覺指示（如地板標線、顏色區分）
blocks.en: Clear visual indication (such as floor markings or color differentiation)

blocks.zh: 物理屏障（如 RABS 擋板、懸掛式隔簾）
blocks.en: Physical barriers (such as RABS panels or suspended curtains)

blocks.zh: Grade C 進入 Grade B 時，必須設置人員與物料分離的獨立氣閘。Grade B 人員氣閘中最後階段更衣處需達到 ISO 7「靜態」條件。
blocks.en: When entering Grade B from Grade C, separate airlocks for personnel and materials must be provided. The final gowning stage of a Grade B personnel airlock must meet ISO 7 "at-rest" conditions.

blocks.zh: 快速自測
blocks.en: Quick Self-Test

blocks.zh: 一名技術人員需要從倉庫（未分級）進入 Grade B 無菌充填室。請列出他需要經過的所有氣閘和更衣步驟：
blocks.en: A technician needs to go from the warehouse (unclassified) into a Grade B aseptic filling room. List all the airlocks and gowning steps he must pass through:

blocks.zh: 未分級 → Grade D 氣閘（換廠服）
blocks.en: Unclassified → Grade D airlock (change into plant garments)

blocks.zh: Grade D → Grade C 人員氣閘（穿第一層無塵衣）
blocks.en: Grade D → Grade C personnel airlock (put on first-layer cleanroom garments)

blocks.zh: Grade C → Grade B 人員氣閘（穿完整無菌衣 + 手套 + 護目鏡，最後更衣處達 ISO 7 靜態）
blocks.en: Grade C → Grade B personnel airlock (put on full sterile garments + gloves + goggles; final gowning area meets ISO 7 at-rest)

blocks.zh: Grade B → Grade A：無氣閘，但有視覺標示與物理屏障
blocks.en: Grade B → Grade A: no airlock, but with visual markings and physical barriers

blocks.zh: 氣閘設計策略  |  p. 99–101
blocks.en: Airlock Design Strategy | p. 99-101

blocks.zh: 氣閘設計基本原則
blocks.en: Basic Principles of Airlock Design

blocks.zh: 氣閘壓差與門互鎖
blocks.en: Airlock Pressure Differentials and Door Interlocks

blocks.zh: 氣流方向：從高等級流向低等級（正壓向外推）
blocks.en: Airflow direction: From higher grade to lower grade (positive pressure pushing outward)

blocks.zh: 壓差維持：氣閘本身應對低等級側保持正壓
blocks.en: Pressure differential maintenance: The airlock itself should be kept at positive pressure relative to the lower-grade side

blocks.zh: 門互鎖（Interlock）：兩扇門不得同時打開，可用機械互鎖或電子連鎖+警報
blocks.en: Door interlock: The two doors must not be open at the same time; use a mechanical interlock or an electronic interlock with alarm

blocks.zh: 密閉 vs. 防護 — 壓差方向的例外
blocks.en: Containment vs. Protection - Exceptions to Pressure Direction

blocks.zh: 當需要「防護」（Containment）時，壓差方向可能反轉 — 例如處理高活性或高毒性產品時，氣閘需要對產品區保持負壓，防止有害物質外洩。此時需要風險評估來權衡：
blocks.en: When "containment" is needed, the pressure differential direction may be reversed. For example, when handling highly active or highly toxic products, the airlock must be kept at negative pressure relative to the product area to prevent hazardous substances from escaping. A risk assessment is then required to weigh:

blocks.zh: 產品汙染風險（外界進入）
blocks.en: Product contamination risk (ingress from outside)

blocks.zh: 交叉汙染風險（產品間）
blocks.en: Cross-contamination risk (between products)

blocks.zh: 操作人員安全（有害物質外洩）
blocks.en: Operator safety (escape of hazardous substances)

blocks.zh: 4.6.3.1 Personnel Airlocks (PAL) 4.6.3.1 人員氣閘 (PAL)
blocks.en: 4.6.3.1 Personnel Airlocks (PAL)

blocks.zh: 人員氣閘（PAL）設計
blocks.en: Personnel Airlock (PAL) Design

blocks.zh: PAL 設計五要素
blocks.en: Five Elements of PAL Design

blocks.zh: 單向流動：進入與離開應使用不同路線（Grade C 以上）
blocks.en: One-way flow: Entry and exit should use different routes (Grade C and above)

blocks.zh: 跨越板凳（Step-over Bench）：Grade C 與 Grade B 的 PAL 中用於穿鞋套，劃分乾淨側與髒側
blocks.en: Step-over bench: Used in Grade C and Grade B PALs for putting on shoe covers, dividing the clean side from the dirty side

blocks.zh: 更衣鏡：讓人員自我檢查更衣完整性
blocks.en: Gowning mirror: Lets personnel check the completeness of their own gowning

blocks.zh: 門禁控制：確保只有經過更衣訓練的人員進入
blocks.en: Access control: Ensures that only personnel trained in gowning can enter

blocks.zh: 洗手設施：洗手水槽僅限 Grade D 以下；Grade C 以上使用乾洗手液
blocks.en: Handwashing facilities: Handwashing sinks only in Grade D and below; Grade C and above use alcohol-based hand sanitizer

blocks.zh: 為什麼高等級區不能有水槽？
blocks.en: Why Can't Higher-Grade Areas Have Sinks?

blocks.zh: 水槽是微生物的溫床 — 水、有機物、溫度三者結合，是理想的微生物培養環境。排水管線更可能藏匿 Pseudomonas 等水源性微生物。因此 ISPE 規定 Grade C 以上區域以乾洗手液取代水洗。這也呼應了 4.5.2 中「無菌區禁止排水口」的原則。
blocks.en: Sinks are a breeding ground for microorganisms: water, organic matter and warmth together make an ideal culture environment. Drain lines can also harbor waterborne organisms such as Pseudomonas. ISPE therefore specifies that areas of Grade C and above use hand sanitizer instead of water washing. This also echoes the principle in 4.5.2 that there should be no drains in aseptic areas.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Step-over Bench 就像鞋店的試穿凳
blocks.en: Analogy: the step-over bench is like a shoe store fitting bench

blocks.zh: 跨越板凳的功能就像鞋店的試穿凳 — 你坐下來，把街上穿的鞋脫掉放在凳子的「髒側」，腳跨過凳子到「乾淨側」穿上無塵鞋套。這個簡單的物理隔離確保地板上的汙染物不會被鞋底帶進潔淨區。
blocks.en: The step-over bench works like a fitting bench in a shoe store: you sit down, take off your street shoes and leave them on the "dirty side" of the bench, then swing your feet across to the "clean side" and put on cleanroom shoe covers. This simple physical separation ensures that contaminants on the floor are not carried into the clean area on the soles of shoes.

blocks.zh: 4.6.3.2 Material Airlocks (MAL) 4.6.3.2 物料氣閘 (MAL)
blocks.en: 4.6.3.2 Material Airlocks (MAL)

blocks.zh: 物料氣閘（MAL）設計
blocks.en: Material Airlock (MAL) Design

blocks.zh: MAL 的獨特設計要求
blocks.en: Unique Design Requirements of a MAL

blocks.zh: 空間尺寸：必須能容納物料在消毒劑停留時間（Dwell Time）內暫存，同時讓人員有足夠操作空間
blocks.en: Space and size: Must be able to hold materials during the disinfectant dwell time, while leaving personnel enough room to work

blocks.zh: 轉換線：MAL 內設置轉換線，物料必須經過擦拭或拆除外包裝後才能越線
blocks.en: Transition line: A transition line is set up inside the MAL; materials may cross it only after being wiped down or de-packaged

blocks.zh: 人員限制：人員可以在 MAL 內更衣（僅為協助物料移動），但不可經由 MAL 路線進入生產區
blocks.en: Personnel restriction: Personnel may gown inside the MAL (only to assist with moving materials), but must not enter the production area via the MAL route

blocks.zh: 逐級通行：低等級人員可進入 MAL 的入口側（髒側），但不可跨越轉換線
blocks.en: Sequential passage: Lower-grade personnel may enter the entry side (dirty side) of the MAL, but must not cross the transition line

blocks.zh: 自動化 vs. 手動傳遞
blocks.en: Automated vs. Manual Transfer

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：手動將物料傳入 Grade B 的方式，通常不如自動滅菌系統或除汙腔室可靠。建議在可行情況下使用自動化方案（如 VHP 除汙傳遞艙、隧道式烘箱）。若仍需手動傳遞，必須確保消毒劑有足夠的接觸停留時間（Dwell Time），以達到有效的消毒效果。
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly states that manually passing materials into Grade B is generally less reliable than automated sterilization systems or decontamination chambers. Where feasible, an automated solution (such as a VHP decontamination pass-through chamber or a tunnel oven) is recommended. If manual transfer is still required, you must ensure the disinfectant has sufficient contact time (dwell time) to achieve effective disinfection.

blocks.zh: 4.6.3.3 & 4.6.3.4 Same Grade / Exit Airlocks 4.6.3.3 & 4.6.3.4 同級/出口氣閘
blocks.en: 4.6.3.3 & 4.6.3.4 Same Grade / Exit Airlocks

blocks.zh: 同級通行與出口氣閘
blocks.en: Same-Grade Passage and Exit Airlocks

blocks.zh: 同級通行
blocks.en: Same-Grade Passage

blocks.zh: 在相同等級區域之間移動，不需要額外更衣。但如果涉及人員防護（如高活性藥物）或物料防護（防止交叉汙染），仍需額外措施。
blocks.en: Moving between areas of the same grade requires no additional gowning. However, additional measures are still needed where personnel protection (such as for highly active drugs) or material protection (to prevent cross-contamination) is involved.

blocks.zh: 出口氣閘設計原則
blocks.en: Exit Airlock Design Principles

blocks.zh: 原則上，人員與物料可共用出口氣閘
blocks.en: In principle, personnel and materials may share an exit airlock

blocks.zh: 高等級區域建議分開 — 因為脫衣程序繁複且物料流量大
blocks.en: Separation is recommended for higher-grade areas, because the de-gowning procedure is complex and material traffic is heavy

blocks.zh: 當物料需要化學消毒且有停留時間要求時，必須分設獨立氣閘
blocks.en: Where materials require chemical disinfection with a dwell time requirement, separate airlocks must be provided

blocks.zh: 出口設計常被忽略
blocks.en: Exit Design Is Often Overlooked

blocks.zh: 許多設施在設計時把重點放在「入口」，卻忽略了「出口」的汙染控制。其實出口也是風險點 — 脫衣過程中釋放的微粒、廢棄物料的處理、以及開門時的氣流擾動，都可能影響高等級區域的環境完整性。
blocks.en: Many facilities focus on the "entrance" in design and neglect contamination control at the "exit". The exit is also a risk point: particles released during de-gowning, the handling of waste materials, and airflow disturbance when doors are opened can all affect the environmental integrity of the higher-grade area.
Pass Boxes | p. 100-101

blocks.zh: 傳遞窗（Pass Box）
blocks.en: Pass Box

blocks.zh: 傳遞窗 vs. 物料氣閘
blocks.en: Pass Box vs. Material Airlock

blocks.zh: 傳遞窗（Pass Box / Pass-Through）：用於小型物品（樣品、容器、廢棄物等），體積較小，通常嵌入牆壁
blocks.en: Pass box (Pass Box / Pass-Through): Used for small items (samples, containers, waste, etc.); smaller in size and usually built into the wall

blocks.zh: 物料氣閘（MAL）：用於大型設備、整批物料，需要人員進入操作
blocks.en: Material airlock (MAL): Used for large equipment and whole batches of material, and requires personnel to enter and operate

blocks.zh: 兩者都必須具備門互鎖功能，兩扇門不得同時開啟
blocks.en: Both must have door interlocks, so that the two doors cannot be opened at the same time

blocks.zh: 傳遞窗的建材與表面處理必須符合其所在房間的等級要求
blocks.en: The construction materials and finishes of a pass box must meet the grade requirements of the room in which it is located

blocks.zh: 比喻：銀行的氣動傳遞筒
blocks.en: Analogy: the bank pneumatic tube

blocks.zh: 傳遞窗就像銀行得來速（Drive-through）的氣動傳遞筒 — 你把文件放進去、關上你這邊的門、銀行行員打開另一邊取出。兩端的門永遠不會同時打開，物品在密閉通道中完成轉移。差別在於潔淨室的傳遞窗還可能內建 UV 燈或 HEPA 過濾器來進一步降低汙染風險。
blocks.en: A pass box is like the pneumatic tube at a bank drive-through: you put your documents in, close the door on your side, and the teller opens the other side to take them out. The doors at both ends are never open at the same time, and the item is transferred inside a closed passage. The difference is that a cleanroom pass box may also have a built-in UV lamp or HEPA filter to further reduce contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 綜合練習：設計一個 Grade C 到 Grade B 的傳遞方案
blocks.en: Integrated Exercise: Design a Grade C to Grade B Transfer Scheme

blocks.zh: 你的設施需要將以下三類物品從 Grade C 傳入 Grade B 無菌充填室。請為每類物品選擇適當的傳遞方式：
blocks.en: Your facility needs to transfer the following three types of items from Grade C into a Grade B aseptic filling room. Choose a suitable transfer method for each type:

blocks.zh: 環境監測培養皿（小型） — 適合使用傳遞窗（Pass Box），內部可擦拭消毒
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring settle plates (small) - suited to a pass box, whose interior can be wiped and disinfected

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼充填零件（中型，需滅菌） — 建議使用自動除汙傳遞艙或隧道式乾熱滅菌爐
blocks.en: Stainless steel filling parts (medium, require sterilization) - an automated decontamination pass-through chamber or a tunnel dry-heat sterilizer is recommended

blocks.zh: 整托盤的玻璃瓶（大型批量） — 需使用物料氣閘（MAL），搭配轉換線與擦拭消毒程序
blocks.en: Full pallets of glass vials (large batch) - require a material airlock (MAL), with a transition line and a wipe-down disinfection procedure

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節重點摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Five functional zones: Sterile facilities are organized from the aseptic core outward through preparation, pharmaceutical, and support zones, each requiring progressively less stringent controls. / 五大功能區：無菌設施從核心無菌區向外依序為準備區、製藥區、支援區，環境控制逐步遞減。
blocks.en: Five functional zones: Sterile facilities are organized from the aseptic core outward through preparation, pharmaceutical, and support zones, each requiring progressively less stringent controls.

blocks.zh: Changing room design: Ingress/egress separation, logical gowning progression, grade-matched finishes, and isolation from toilet facilities are essential. / 更衣室設計：進出分離、邏輯更衣動線、等級匹配的表面處理、與廁所隔離為四大要件。
blocks.en: Changing room design: Ingress/egress separation, logical gowning progression, grade-matched finishes, and isolation from toilet facilities are essential.

blocks.zh: Surface finishes escalate by grade: From standard construction (unclassified) to seamless, non-porous, coved, stainless steel finishes (Grade A), with no drains permitted in aseptic areas. / 表面處理隨等級升級：從標準建材到無縫、不滲透、圓弧化、不鏽鋼處理，無菌區禁止排水口。
blocks.en: Surface finishes escalate by grade: From standard construction (unclassified) to seamless, non-porous, coved, stainless steel finishes (Grade A), with no drains permitted in aseptic areas.

blocks.zh: Transfer zones maintain contamination barriers: Airlocks use pressure differentials, door interlocks, and improvement steps (cleaning/gowning) to prevent contamination ingress. / 傳遞區維持汙染屏障：氣閘利用壓差、門互鎖、改善步驟來防止汙染侵入。
blocks.en: Transfer zones maintain contamination barriers: Airlocks use pressure differentials, door interlocks, and improvement steps (cleaning/gowning) to prevent contamination ingress.

blocks.zh: Sequential one-grade-at-a-time transitions: Entry must progress one classification step at a time; Grade A is accessed only from Grade B without a separate airlock but with clear visual/physical barriers. / 逐級轉換：進入必須逐級升級；Grade A 只能從 Grade B 進入，無獨立氣閘但需明確視覺/物理屏障。
blocks.en: Sequential one-grade-at-a-time transitions: Entry must progress one classification step at a time; Grade A is accessed only from Grade B without a separate airlock but with clear visual/physical barriers.

blocks.zh: PAL vs. MAL vs. Pass Box: Personnel and material airlocks serve different functions; pass boxes replace MALs for smaller items; all require door interlocks and grade-appropriate construction. / 人員氣閘、物料氣閘與傳遞窗各有適用場景，均需門互鎖與等級匹配建材。
blocks.en: PAL vs. MAL vs. Pass Box: Personnel and material airlocks serve different functions; pass boxes replace MALs for smaller items; all require door interlocks and grade-appropriate construction.
